title: Toyota Supra MK4
author: VicWiz
description:
3D Model of the **Toyota Supra MK4**, Ideal for motorsports fans, model builders, and anyone wanting to print a detailed version of this iconic Japanese sports car

Perfect for

- Decorative prints
- Automotive modeling
- Customization, painting, and dioramas
- JDM classic car collectors

The model can be scaled as needed and works well on most 3D printers

toyota 2000 SUPRA supra car \- 3dprint 3D model decorate decoration free race run motor 2jz Japanese japan fast fast and furious cars

storage.note: 3MF files are stored as .3mf.xz to stay under GitHub's 100MB limit. Decompress with `xz -d -k <file>` before use; SHA-256 is computed on the compressed file.
